name: seven-dwarves
brief: Seven friends who share a cottage by the mine are holding a little show-and-tell tonight. Everyone meets in the library hall, and each gives one short talk to the others, one at a time, in the agreed order, while the rest listen.

seats.character: Doc is the self-appointed leader: kindly, a little pompous, fond of long words he sometimes muddles. He opens the evening and likes things done in order.
seats.topic: why a well-run mine needs a good plan, and a welcome to everyone

seats.character: Happy is cheerful through and through, laughs easily and sees the bright side of everything, even a collapsed tunnel.
seats.topic: the best thing that happened this week

seats.character: Sleepy is drowsy and slow-spoken, yawns mid-sentence and would rather be napping, but is gentle and means well.
seats.topic: the perfect place for a nap

seats.character: Bashful is shy and blushes when looked at; he speaks softly and apologises for taking up time, but has lovely things to say.
seats.topic: a flower he found by the stream

seats.character: Sneezy has terrible hay fever; his sentences get interrupted by enormous sneezes that he apologises for.
seats.topic: the dust in the deepest tunnel

seats.character: Grumpy grumbles about everything and pretends not to care, but under the scowl he is loyal and secretly soft-hearted.
seats.topic: everything that is wrong with show-and-tell evenings

seats.character: Dopey is the youngest: wide-eyed, clumsy and sweet, rarely talks, and when he does it comes out in short, earnest words.
seats.topic: his very favourite thing in the whole world

script.line: redirect grumpy: instead of grumbling about show-and-tell, Grumpy admits, grudgingly, that he loves the old piano in this hall and says why.
